finalAcceptance.boundary: Actual HA candidate image running as root through /init with mock Supervisor; Paseo/Smart core47 only. Real HA Supervisor/HA OS/hardware/accounts require a separately designated installation.

verificationHistory.cause: Verification script assumed CLI public status exposed internal state; use readState read-only for providerReloadPending.

harnessHistory.additionalRunReason: Final-verification helper import unintentionally executed the QA module main before its import guard was added.

importGuard.fix: QA main executes only when launched directly; importing helper functions is inert.

r4.nativeAndSkillsIndependentReviewScope: The nested productRepoModifiedByThisTask=false and r3ReceiptsPreserved=true refer to the isolated native/skills QA task. Source upgrade changes and later QA import-guard history are recorded separately.

observation.releaseNotesScope: Mostly client UI (Settings reorganized into Device and Host sections, model picker arrow keys, Tailscale refresh); small server fixes; Antigravity usage source removed.

officialClient0176.scope: Paseo profile only, zero model calls, R4 canonical image fixture; official profile restored afterwards. The 32-case Web UI suite on 0.17.6 is recorded separately.

paasCandidateExpiry.mechanism: scripts/close-expired-approvals.sh runs every 15 minutes and calls scripts/cleanup-candidate-tag.sh for an expired approval issue, deleting the -pending-approval candidate tag.
paasCandidateExpiry.consequence: The PaaS R4 candidate no longer exists; the isolated PaaS R4 QA pod keeps running from its node image cache. Reuse requires re-pushing the tag and a new approval within 180 minutes.

remainingGates: Authenticated Claude/Codex/Pi conversations, streaming, stop, resume, model switching and actual skill/MCP calls: test account/instance not selected. Voice/microphone and agent-backed task/schedule execution are not accepted by the zero-model suites.

Real HA OS/Supervisor/Core/hardware, native Podman/systemd host and native arm64 runtime acceptance require designated test hosts; current real-image execution used amd64 k3s and a mock HA Supervisor.

Fixed R3 frontend cohorts: Smart production 0.17.4 lacks official 0.17.5 workspace selection UI; N-12 FAIL remains a frontend difference. This is not an R4 frontend retest or a fix by this runtime branch.

PaaS R4 was tested with fresh PVCs while its candidate existed; a PaaS same-PVC image upgrade was not run and cannot run until the candidate is rebuilt. The separate canonical R3-to-R4 preserving image upgrade passed.
Standalone k3s/PaaS source contexts match across 631 tracked file modes and contents; no additional standalone k3s artifact was built or published.

No merge, Release, existing tenant rollout or stable/default chart image promotion. The PaaS candidate was removed when approval issue #808 expired (11-27 04:00Z); promotion would need a re-pushed tag and a new human approval.

Official Paseo web moved to 0.17.6 on 2026-11-27; all R3/R4 results were obtained on 0.17.5 (official) and 0.17.4 (Smart). Core compatibility on 0.17.6 passed (15/15, Paseo profile); the 32-case Web navigation/preferences suite has only an R3 baseline and is being re-run on R4.
